sponsored.t: Enacts the Empowering People in Rights Enforcement (EMPIRE) Worker Protection Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Empowering People in Rights Enforcement (EMPIRE) Worker Protection Act"; relates to the delegation of state enforcement authority to private actors; authorizes an affected employee, whistleblower, representative organization or an organizational deputy to initiate a public enforcement action on behalf of the commissioner for certain provisions of the labor law, or any regulation promulgated thereunder.
sponsored.fis: Will result in increased revenue for the State.

sponsored.t: Imposes certain requirements on institutions housing a defendant due to mental disease or defect prior to the discharge of such defendant
sponsored.sum: Requires each appropriate institution housing a defendant due to mental disease or defect to assign a critical time intervention care management team to the defendant and make a single point of access referral for the defendant prior to such defendant's discharge.

sponsored.t: Requires comparison of prices charged by energy services companies
sponsored.sum: Requires that a billing statement delivered to the customer by an energy services company include a side-by-side comparison showing both the price charged by the energy service company for commodity and delivery service during the prior billing period, and the price the customer would have paid had they taken commodity and delivery service from their local utility corporation or municipality; requires an energy service company to provide each of its customers with an annual statement comparing the price charged by the energy service company for commodity and delivery services and other energy-related value-added products over the prior twelve-month period with the price such customer would…

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 65 Chapter 685 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 3876, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to requiring comparison of prices charged by energy services companies" APPROVED This bill would require each billing statement for an ESCO customer to include a side-by-side comparison of the price charged by the ESCO and the charges the customer would have paid if they were a customer of the incumbent utility, along with an itemized list of any additional charges for products provided by the ESCO. I fully support empowering ESCO customers and promoting information transparency through providing on-bill price comparisons of ESCO…

sponsored.t: Protects individuals who provide or receive legally protected health activity from criminal or civil liability or professional sanctions imposed by jurisdictions outside the state; repealer
sponsored.sum: Protects individuals who provide or receive legally protected health activity, including reproductive health care and gender-affirming care, from criminal or civil liability or professional sanctions imposed by jurisdictions outside the state.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 71 Chapter 694 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 4914-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the civil practice law and rules, the education law, the public health law, the judiciary law, the insurance law, the general business law, the criminal procedure law, the executive law, the civil rights law, and the family court act, in relation to protecting individuals who provide or receive legally protected health activity from criminal or civil liabil- ity or professional sanctions imposed by jurisdictions outside the state; and to repeal certain provisions of the criminal procedure law and the executive law relating thereto" APPROVED This bill strengthens existing laws to better ensure that New York does not participate in attempts to penalize the provision of reproduc- tive or gender-affirming care, referred to in the bill as "legally protected health activity".…

sponsored.t: Relates to the scope of certain provisions relating to beneficial owners of limited liability companies
sponsored.sum: Amends the definitions of the terms "beneficial owner", "reporting company" and "exempt company" to set the scope of certain provisions relating to beneficial owners of limited liability companies; authorizes the department of state to further clarify any such definitions.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting provisions for the execution of electronic wills
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions for the execution of electronic wills including attestation, revocation and filing.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 24 Chapter 637 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 7416-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the estates, powers and trusts law and the state technology law, in relation to electronic wills" APPROVED This bill would add a new Article 3 Part 6 of the Estates, Powers and Trusts Law to allow for the execution and filing of electronic wills and make conforming changes in various statutes. sponsored.t: Relates to split shifts for election inspectors or poll clerks
sponsored.sum: Relates to split shifts for election inspectors or poll clerks.

sponsored.t: Provides for the types of damages that may be awarded to the persons for whose benefit an action for wrongful death is brought
sponsored.sum: Provides for the types of damages that may be awarded to the persons for whose benefit an action for wrongful death is brought.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 87 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 4423, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the estates, powers and trusts law, in relation to the payment and distribution of damages in wrongful death actions" NOT APPROVED This bill would significantly alter the legal framework for wrongful death actions in New York by expanding the types of damages that may be recovered, expanding the class of persons who may seek such damages and extending the statute of limitations. sponsored.t: Requires Medicaid to cover gender-affirming care regardless of federal funding; prohibits discriminatory practices by health care entities and insurers; relates to coverage for treatment for gender dysphoria
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid to cover gender-affirming care regardless of federal funding; prohibits discriminatory practices by health care entities including hospitals, certain professionals, and insurers; requires insurance coverage for services or treatments for gender dysphoria or gender incongruence.

sponsored.t: Relates to an affirmation by any person, wherever made, in a civil action
sponsored.sum: Expands the acceptable uses of affirmations in civil actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to judges presiding over designated youth parts
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding eligibility for judges presiding over designated youth parts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the computation and allocation of the commissions of trustees of charitable trusts; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the computation and allocation of the commissions of trustees of charitable trusts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of certain immunizations
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a licensed pharmacist to administer any recommendations made by the commissioner of health pertaining to a vaccine that has been authorized by the federal Food and Drug Administration; relates to insurance coverage for immunizations; removes the requirement to follow the advisory committee on immunization practices of the centers for disease control and prevention recommendation for immunization against meningococcal disease.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Jack Reid Law: Protect All Students Act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination against and harassment or bullying of students by other students on school property or at a school function; requires schools to investigate reports of bullying; requires schools to adopt a written, plain-language anti-bullying and harassment policy; requires school employees to report incidents of bullying or harassment.
sponsored.fis: None to the state or local governments.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of algorithmic pricing by landlords for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a person or entity from knowingly or with reckless disregard facilitate an agreement between or among two or more residential rental property owners or managers to not compete with respect to residential rental dwelling units, including by operating or licensing a software, data analytics service, or algorithmic device that performs a coordinating function on behalf of or between and among such residential rental property owners or managers.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions arising out of consumer debt
sponsored.sum: Relates to action arising out of consumer debt; defines consumer debt and replaces consumer credit transaction with such term.

sponsored.t: Establishes civil liability for the deprivation of any rights, privileges, or immunities secured by the federal or state constitution
sponsored.sum: Provides that every person who, under color of any statute, ordinance, regulation, custom, or usage, of the United States, subjects or causes to be subjected any citizen of New York or other person within the jurisdiction thereof to the deprivation of any rights, privileges, or immunities secured by the federal or state constitution shall be liable to the injured party in an action at law, suit in equity, or other proper proceeding.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 470 of the judiciary law relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to allowing attorneys having offices in the state to reside in an adjoining state.
sponsored.fis: TO STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS: None

sponsored.t: Repeals section 2307 of the public health law relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership
sponsored.sum: Prohibits pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership where over fifty percent of the units are shareholder occupied.

sponsored.t: Relates to the submission of requests to the committee on special education for the educational services mandated by an individualized education services program
sponsored.sum: Requires the school district of location shall annually provide written notice to all parents or persons in parental relation to students with disabilities attending nonpublic schools within their district regarding the process for requesting special education services; relates to the denial of services in a city having a population of one million or more for the 2024--2025 school year.

sponsored.t: Relates to admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress in civil actions or proceedings; provides limited exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence in a civil action
sponsored.sum: Requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Francesco's law"; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Francesco's law" which establishes violations for the failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms in the presence of a minor or a prohibited person; requires the office of gun violence prevention to collect and analyze statistical and other information and data with respect to injuries or deaths of minors resulting from failure to safely store a firearm, rifle, or shotgun.

sponsored.t: Relates to class actions
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the restriction on class actions involving a penalty or minimum recovery; adds language expressly permitting class actions against governmental entities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders to prohibit settlement agreements which conceal a public hazard or any information that would identify a public hazard.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the legislature to increase the number of justices of the supreme court in any judicial district
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the legislature to increase the number of justices of the supreme court in any judicial district.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city department of buildings to confirm that there are no tenants living at certain properties prior to approving or issuing permits for demolition or substantial alteration
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city department of buildings to confirm that there are no tenants living at certain properties prior to approving or issuing permits for the demolition or the substantial alteration or renovation of such properties.

sponsored.t: Relates to arbitration proceedings
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions of law governing arbitration proceedings; specifies fees and expenses with regard to employment or consumer arbitration proceedings; directs certain sanctions on a party which breaches an arbitration agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age limitation for judges
sponsored.sum: Provides that a judge of a city court outside the city of New York may only serve until the last day of December next after such person shall be seventy-six years of age; makes exceptions for judges already elected or appointed to office.

sponsored.t: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception
sponsored.sum: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the storage of flavored vapor products near where vapor or tobacco products are sold at retail or wholesale
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the keeping of inventory, storage, warehouse, processing, packaging, shipping or distributing of flavored vapor products near where vapor or tobacco products are sold at retail or wholesale.

sponsored.t: Relates to a private right of action concerning sidewalk sheds
sponsored.sum: Creates a private right of action by a tenant against a landlord in a city having a population of one million or more persons over sidewalk sheds.

sponsored.t: Establishes "The Equity in Fertility Treatment Act"; relates to the definition of infertility and health insurance coverage for the treatment of infertility
sponsored.sum: Establishes "The Equity in Fertility Treatment Act"; relates to the definition of infertility and health insurance coverage for the treatment of infertility.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the exclusion of coverage based upon gender indication on insurance claim forms
sponsored.sum: Relates to gender indication on insurance claim forms; provides policies shall not exclude coverage if gender indication is different from sex assigned at birth or gender otherwise recorded.

sponsored.t: Relates to utilization review program standards and pre-authorization for certain health care services
sponsored.sum: Relates to utilization review program standards; requires use of evidence-based and peer reviewed clinical review criteria; relates to prescription drug formulary changes and pre-authorization for certain health care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions for illegal and improper practices of commercial towing companies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a lien against personal and real property of the owner of a commercial towing company for illegal and improper practices; creates personal liability for members of an LLC and certain corporate shareholders.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee
sponsored.sum: Prohibits agreements between employers that directly restrict the current or future employment of any employee; allows for a cause of action against employers who engage in such agreements.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the vacating of an arbitration award on the basis of arbitrator disregard of the law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the vacating of an arbitration award on the basis of arbitrator disregard of the law.

sponsored.t: Relates to the mandatory retirement age of judges and justices
sponsored.sum: Provides a mandatory retirement age for judges and justices.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the available jurisdiction for issuing information subpoenas
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Allows for the issuance of information subpoenas on behalf of small claims judgment creditors to be effective anywhere in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to banning the use of biometric identifying technology in schools
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of biometric identifying technology in schools for any reason other than certain specified purposes; adds fingerprint identification of teachers, administrators and students for the purpose of securely logging into a digital device for academic and administrative purpose to allowable purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to peer-to-peer mobile payment service security
sponsored.sum: Directs every peer-to-peer mobile service to require users to create a personal identification code associated with the user's account that is required to be used when certain actions are taken and to require users to set a monetary amount for intended transfers above which the use of a personal identification number will be required to authenticate the user's identity.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions and proceedings seeking an abatement of rent based on violations of the housing maintenance code
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions and proceedings seeking an abatement of rent based on violations of the housing maintenance code, applicable housing standards, the building code, or the health code; relates to the number of housing judges assigned to certain actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to pro bono service by attorneys and candidates for admission to the bar
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a requirement of pro bono service as a condition of admission to the bar or attorney registration; exempts pro bono work performed pursuant to an agreement with the federal government if the federal government designates the recipients of the pro bono work or type or types or nature of such legal services; provides for the expiration of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to compliance by New York city marshals with filing requirement regarding service of a notice of eviction
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires New York city marshals to complete an electronic filing within one business day of service of a notice of eviction.

sponsored.t: Prohibits landlords from including incorrect information re rent decontrol in certain leases and renewals pertaining to units in the Affordable New York Housing Program
sponsored.sum: Prohibits landlords from including incorrect information relating to rent decontrol in certain leases and renewals thereof; imposes a violation punishable by a fine of $1000 for a violation by a landlord; requires the standardization of certain notices pertaining to units subject to the Affordable New York Housing Program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and authority of the state commission on judicial conduct
sponsored.sum: Relates to complaints regarding judges and confidentiality of records; extends the jurisdiction of the state commission on judicial conduct as to judges who resign or retire while under investigation or formal charges.

sponsored.t: Provides for including siblings of parents and children of siblings in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members
sponsored.sum: Provides for including siblings of parents and children of siblings in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members to succeed in certain cases to the rights of certain tenants.
sponsored.fis: None or negligible to the State.

sponsored.t: Relates to the tax exemption of a mutual redevelopment company
sponsored.sum: Relates to the extension of a tax exemption for a mutual redevelopment company in a city having a population of one million or more persons.
sponsored.fis: This bill would have no meaningful State fiscal impact.

sponsored.t: Relates to the standards for openable windows in residential units
sponsored.sum: Requires openable windows in residential units to comply with certain mechanical ventilation standards.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impact on the state

sponsored.t: Relates to the medical aid in dying act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the medical aid in dying act; relates to a terminally ill patient's request for and use of medication for medical aid in dying.

sponsored.t: Lowers quorum requirements for meetings of community boards held by videoconferencing
sponsored.sum: Provides that, for a quorum, an advisory board may require that at a minimum, one quarter of the members and the presiding officer of a community board physically be present at a location where the public can attend for such board to conduct videoconferencing.

sponsored.t: Prevents a judge from prohibiting a parent from undergoing a gender reassignment when making a determination in a child custody case
sponsored.sum: Provides that the judge shall not prohibit a parent from undergoing gender reassignment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the contents of claims
sponsored.sum: Provides exceptions from the requirement of specificity in pleadings in certain cases involving sexual offenses.

sponsored.t: Requires that an organization applying for grant funding shall provide to arts agencies a certification that it will enter into a labor peace agreement with at least one bona fide labor organization
sponsored.sum: Requires that an organization applying for grant funding shall provide to arts agencies a certification that it will enter into a labor peace agreement with at least one bona fide labor organization either where such bona fide labor organization is actively representing employees providing services covered by the organization seeking such grant funding or upon notice by a bona fide labor organization that is attempting to represent employees who will provide services to the organization seeking such grant funding; relates to prevailing wage requirements for not-for-profit theaters and payment of their employees on productions funded by the New York state council on the arts or arts agencies…

sponsored.t: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings by the media; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to audio-visual coverage of judicial proceedings by the media; allows the judge or justice presiding over a proceeding to exercise discretion to prohibit or limit filming or photographing of particular participants; defines terms; provides limitations on audio-visual coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of writings and objects to refresh recollection
sponsored.sum: Relates to when an adverse party is entitled to production of a writing, object, or other material a witness has used to refresh the witness' recollection.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of business entity; and relates to the allowance and application of the newspaper and broadcast media jobs tax credit
sponsored.sum: Includes not-for-profit corporations and public television or radio corporations in the definition of business entity; allows such entities to claim the newspaper and broadcast media jobs tax credit.

sponsored.t: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent
sponsored.sum: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent.
sponsored.fis: The increased dollar amount for an automobile which could be set off to a spouse and children may result in decreased in filings of administra- tive petitions and commensurate reduction in the time of court personnel to review such filings. The loss of filing fees which might have been received will be offset by the savings of time for court personnel.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of drilling fluids, brine and flowback water from gas or oil wells, pools, or fields on any highway
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of drilling fluids, brine and flowback water from gas or oil wells, pools, or fields on any highway for any purpose including but not limited to de-icing or dust suppression.

sponsored.t: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants a fee for a dishonored rent check in excess of the actual costs or fees incurred by such landlord as a result thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants a fee for a dishonored rent check in excess of the actual costs or fees incurred by such landlord as a result thereof, provided such dishonored check fee was included in the initial lease.

sponsored.t: Extends DEC's authority to regulate management of crabs, and prohibits the taking of horseshoe crabs for commercial and biomedical purposes
sponsored.sum: Extends DEC's authority to regulate management of crabs to 12/31/2027; prohibits the taking of horseshoe crabs for commercial and biomedical purposes.

sponsored.t: Criminalizes the harassment of a child; and establishes a private right of action for harassment of a child
sponsored.sum: Criminalizes the harassment of a child when the perpetrator intentionally or knowingly harasses, annoys or alarms a child or a child's parent or guardian; establishes a private right of action for harassment of a child.

sponsored.t: Relates to the business records exception to hearsay
sponsored.sum: Provides additional requirements for certain writings and records to be admissible under the business records hearsay exception.

sponsored.t: Relates to service by former housing court judges of the New York city civil court as judicial hearing officers
sponsored.sum: Provides that any person who has served as a state-paid judge or justice of a court of the unified court system or as a housing judge of the housing portion of the civil court of the city of New York, but who no longer holds any of such offices, may apply to be designated as a judicial hearing officer.
sponsored.fis: This bill would have no meaningful State fiscal impact. 8.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects
sponsored.sum: Permits amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects and the dismissal of a claim based upon claimant's failure to comply with jurisdictional pleading requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a statewide supervised visitation initiative to support safe and structured parenting time
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of victim services, in consultation with the office for the prevention of domestic violence, to establish a statewide supervised visitation initiative including culturally sensitive services that provide language access for those who need it and that are affordable for those with limited means to pay; requires the submission of regular assessments and reports.
sponsored.fis: Yes, requires state budget funding to implement.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance requirements for third-party food delivery services
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycle delivery contractors to provide personal injury liability insurance to compensate persons injured by a bicycle delivery worker and to provide notice to delivery workers that the contractor provides personal injury liability insurance; authorizes the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the definition of business records and the use of such records in grand jury proceedings
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the definition of business records and the use of such records in grand jury proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to referrals for child support enforcement for foster care maintenance payments
sponsored.sum: Relates to liability to support a child who is placed in foster care pursuant to an approved application for foster care maintenance; provides that such liability shall not be imposed if it will adversely affect the health, safety or welfare of the child on whose behalf such payments are to be made or other persons in the child's household or will adversely affect the length of the child's placement or impair the ability of the child to return home when discharged from foster care; limits the ability of a county or local social services district to cause a referral to be sent for the purpose of commencing collection of child support for a child placed in foster care.

sponsored.t: Relates to the electrification of the Manhattan Cruise Terminal
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York City Economic Development Corporation to immediately commence any proceedings, processes, stakeholder engagement, or capital projects necessary for the installation of shore power capability at the Manhattan Cruise Terminal; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use taxes with respect to certain aircraft; and repeals certain provisions of the tax law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use taxes with respect to certain aircraft; repeals provisions relating to the exemption from sales and compensating use taxes of general aviation aircraft, and machinery or equipment to be installed on such aircraft.
sponsored.fis: Would result in sales and compensating use tax revenue generated for the state.

sponsored.t: Repeals subdivision (jj) of section 1115 of the tax law and subdivision 13 of section 1118 of the tax law relating to sales and compensating use taxes imposed with respect to vessels
sponsored.sum: Relates to sales and compensating use taxes imposed with respect to vessels.
sponsored.fis: Would result in revenue generated for the state.

sponsored.t: Protects wolves
sponsored.sum: Protects canids by requiring animals which could be coyotes or wolves be submitted for a genetic test to determine genetic makeup; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Expands the right to seek the appointment of administrators of buildings to tenants and local governments throughout to make procedures conform with realities of housing stock; repealer
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Expands the right to seek the appointment of administrators of buildings to tenants and local governments throughout the state and to make procedures conform with realities of housing stock throughout the state; repeals certain provisions of the real property actions and proceedings law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fees for any service rendered through a bank relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits fees for any service rendered through a banking organization relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting  A Beautiful Noise, LLC  to file an application for a New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit for 2022
sponsored.sum: Permits "A Beautiful Noise, LLC" to file an application for a New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit for 2022.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; and provides penalties for violations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of certain products that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; requires manufacturers of products containing PFAS to provide notice of such fact to persons that offer the products for sale or distribution; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to making technical corrections to ensure gender neutrality for the admission to practice law and preventing required disclosure of prior interaction with law enforcement or the criminal justice system
sponsored.sum: Relates to making technical corrections to ensure gender neutrality for the admission to practice law and preventing the character fitness questionnaire from inquiring into an applicant's prior interaction with law enforcement or the criminal justice system under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Prohibits Medicaid from requiring prior authorization for certain HIV medications
sponsored.sum: Prohibits Medicaid service providers from requiring prior authorization for antiretroviral prescription drugs for the treatment or prevention of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

sponsored.t: Relates to payment for rapid whole genome sequencing
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of social services to authorize the payment of medical assistance funds for rapid whole genome sequencing for persons under twenty-one years of age under certain medical circumstances.

sponsored.t: Establishes confirmatory adoptions providing for the adoption of children born as a result of assisted reproduction and allows courts to grant custody and support of children from more than two parents; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes confirmatory adoptions providing for the adoption of children born as a result of assisted reproduction; allows for more than two persons to be named parents of a child; establishes presumed parentage and provides for the challenge and adjudication thereof; repeals certain provisions of the domestic relations law and the family court act relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits bank investments in bad faith landlords
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a state chartered banking institution from providing financing to a landlord who has engaged in certain bad faith acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the restriction on certain facilities being located within a certain distance from cannabis storefronts
sponsored.sum: Restricts cannabis storefronts and premises from being located within 500 feet from a school and two hundred feet of a house of worship.

sponsored.t: Requires certain motion picture theaters to provide scheduled showings of motion pictures with open motion picture captioning
sponsored.sum: Requires a motion picture theater that offers more than ten motion picture showings per week to provide scheduled showings of motion pictures with open motion picture captioning such that at least one quarter of all showings of a motion picture with four or more showings during a one-week time period shall have open motion picture captioning; provides exceptions and penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the duty owed by certain agencies to children in the legal custody of the agencies; extends jurisdiction of the court of claims
sponsored.sum: Relates to the duty owed by certain agencies to children in the legal custody of the agencies with respect to the placement of children; provides a statutory private right of action for compensatory damage; extends jurisdiction of the court of claims to certain claims for injuries to a child.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Implications are minimal because the Bill does not change the law but provides a codification and clarification of existing law.

sponsored.t: Relates to records of elevator maintenance or vertical transportation, operation issues and repairs
sponsored.sum: Requires records of elevator or vertical transportation maintenance, operation issues and repairs be made available to the municipal department having jurisdiction over such elevator or vertical transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to major capital improvements and individual apartment improvements in rent regulated units
sponsored.sum: Prohibits temporary major capital improvement increases for buildings where the owner has demonstrated a pattern of violations unless the applicant shows by clear and convincing evidence that the proposed improvement will directly and substantially remedy those violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to excess differential offsets for paraprofessionals employed by board of education
sponsored.sum: Provides that for each fiscal year commencing on or after July 1, 2025, the city of New York shall provide an excess differential offset to each person who was employed by the board of education as a paraprofessional for all or part of such year.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the naming of state buildings after public officers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the naming of state buildings after a public officer during the period in which that person is a public officer or after a public officer who has been convicted of a felony.

sponsored.t: Amends the Uniform Commercial Code to provide for emerging technologies
sponsored.sum: Incorporates the 2022 Uniform Law Commission recommended amendments to the Uniform Commercial Code to provide for emerging technologies; addresses emerging technologies, providing updated rules for commercial transactions involving virtual currencies, distributed ledger technologies (including blockchain), artificial intelligence, and other technological developments.

sponsored.t: Relates to proof of claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment
sponsored.sum: Relates to proof of claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment.

sponsored.t: Relates to obtaining jurisdiction over certain defendants in matters relating to a tenancy or lease
sponsored.sum: Standardizes the language across the relevant court acts to allow tenants statewide to sue in the county where the real property at issue is located in matters relating to a tenancy or lease; requires the Office of Court Administration to develop necessary forms, procedures and deliver a report.

sponsored.t: Prohibits participation in torture and improper treatment of incarcerated individuals by health care professionals
sponsored.sum: Prohibits participation in torture and improper treatment of incarcerated individuals by health care professionals; prohibits a health care professional from engaging, assisting or planning the torture or improper treatment of an incarcerated individual; requires health care professionals to report torture and improper treatment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for a residential parking permit system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for a residential parking permit system to reduce hazards and pollution levels.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for owners of rent-regulated property who overcharge tenants
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for owners of rent-regulated property who overcharge tenants.

sponsored.t: Relates to remedies for a violation of the prohibition on a landlord from refusing to rent due to a tenant's involvement in a prior dispute
sponsored.sum: Provides penalties when a landlord of a residential premises refuses to rent to a potential tenant on the basis that the potential tenant was involved in a past or pending landlord-tenant action or summary proceeding.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and duties of the state commission on judicial conduct
sponsored.sum: Empowers the state commission on judicial conduct to transmit its annual budget request to the governor for inclusion in the executive budget without revision.

sponsored.t: Enacts the monarch preservation plan
sponsored.sum: Enacts the monarch preservation plan requiring the department of environmental conservation to take feasible actions to conserve monarch butterflies and the unique habitats they depend upon for successful migration.

sponsored.t: Relates to alternate jurors
sponsored.sum: Provides that after an alternate juror has been substituted, the jury shall deliberate anew on all issues submitted to the jury at the outset of deliberations; exempts issues for which a verdict was already rendered.

sponsored.t: Relates to the civil jurisdiction of county and district courts
sponsored.sum: Expands the civil jurisdiction of county courts to matters of up to fifty thousand dollars and district courts to matters of up to thirty-five thousand dollars.
sponsored.fis: This bill would have no meaningful State fiscal impact. 8.

sponsored.t: Prohibits using possession of reproductive or sexual health devices as evidence in a trial, hearing or proceeding in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides that possession of a condom or other reproductive or sexual health device may not be received in evidence in any trial, hearing or proceeding as evidence of conduct which would constitute an offense defined in article 230 of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Allows for justices to reside in any town, village or city within the same assembly district as the court such justice serves and establishes educational requirements for certain town and village justices
sponsored.sum: Allows for justices to reside in any town, village or city contained in whole or in part within the same assembly district as the court such justice serves or in an assembly district contiguous to such municipality where the court is located; authorizes towns and villages to require that any person who serves as a town or village justice be admitted to practice law in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the ten year time period from the crime of persistent sexual abuse
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing the ten year time period from the crime of persistent sexual abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to the voting age
sponsored.sum: Provides that the voting age in New York be 16 years old.

sponsored.t: Relates to the location of motor vehicle repair shops
sponsored.sum: Requires a certificate of compliance issued by the department of environmental conservation certifying that a motor vehicle repair shop located next to a school does not contain a coating line.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "emission tampering act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the disabling, removal or interference with emission control devices and the use of emission tampering devices; provides remedies for the violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to restricting the use of electronic monitoring and automated employment decision tools
sponsored.sum: Restricts the use by an employer or an employment agency of electronic monitoring or an automated employment decision tool to screen a candidate or employee for an employment decision unless such tool has been the subject of an impact assessment within the last year; requires notice to employment candidates of the use of such tools; provides remedies for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to disqualification from receiving unemployment benefits when the claimant's employer maintained, refused or failed to cure a health or safety condition that made the environment unsuitable
sponsored.sum: Relates to disqualification from receiving benefits for separation from employment in cases where the claimant's employer maintained or refused to cure a health or safety condition that made the environment unsuitable.

sponsored.t: Relates to charter schools
sponsored.sum: Provides additional requirements for approval of charter school applications; applies additional prohibitions to charter schools; requires certain financial disclosures by charter schools; requires charter schools to comply with provisions relating to construction, repair or demolition of school facilities; relates to admission of students.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of electronic marketplaces for compensation for damages for defective goods
sponsored.sum: Provides that an electronic marketplace provider shall be deemed to be a retailer for purposes of New York strict liability law and shall be strictly liable for all damages caused by defective products placed into the stream of commerce to the same extent that a retailer of that defective product would be liable.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 260.15 of the penal law relating to affirmative defenses to the charge of endangering the welfare of a child
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to affirmative defenses to the charge of endangering the welfare of a child.

sponsored.t: Replaces each instance of the word accident with the word crash in relation to vehicle and traffic law
sponsored.sum: Replaces each instance of the word accident with the word crash in relation to the vehicle and traffic law.

sponsored.t: Requires certain mass transit providers to provide an additional gender option on systems used for reservations, ticketing and check-in in order to accurately reflect a traveler's gender
sponsored.sum: Requires any entity doing business in this state and engaged in the business of mass-transportation of the general public on an airplane, railroad train, bus or cruise ship to update its reservation, ticketing and check-in website applications to include an additional gender marker option to allow travelers to select their gender based on self-attestation, regardless of the sex assigned at birth; provides exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of judges in family court
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of family court judges in the city of New York to seventy-two; provides for two additional family court judges for each of Westchester and Rockland counties and an additional family court judge for each of Erie and Niagara counties.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers and health plans to grant automatic preauthorization approvals to eligible health care professionals in certain circumstance
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers and health plans to grant automatic preauthorization approvals to eligible health care professionals in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding service of process to the department of state in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Expands service of process to the department of state in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts to conduct mandatory early screening for dyslexia for all children
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to conduct mandatory early screening for dyslexia for all children commencing in pre-kindergarten or kindergarten and continuing thereafter on an annual basis until each child successfully completes second grade; requires school districts to designate an individual to maintain complete and accurate records containing early screening reports for each child, and to provide resources and materials to the parent and/or guardian of any child who displays indications of dyslexia.

sponsored.t: Exempts amounts received from any financial settlement for childhood sexual abuse for determining eligibility for or amount of benefits
sponsored.sum: Exempts amounts received from any financial settlement for childhood sexual abuse for determining eligibility for or amount of benefits under any program provided under the social security law.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a cause of action for medical monitoring
sponsored.sum: Establishes a cause of action for medical monitoring for a person with or without a present injury or disease; establishes a statute of limitation for such cause of action.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic filing by an unrepresented party
sponsored.sum: Allows an unrepresented party to transmit legal filings in eviction proceedings electronically; eliminates certain verification or notarization requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to social media open application programming
sponsored.sum: Relates to social media open application programming; requires social media platforms to implement and maintain a standards-based application programming interface that permits third-party applications to retrieve data at no cost to be used for the user's benefit and to provide certain information to users; requires social media companies to submit a report to the attorney general.

sponsored.t: Requires all school districts to screen all students for dyslexia and dysgraphia
sponsored.sum: Requires all school districts to screen all students for dyslexia and dysgraphia; requires school districts to provide notice of such screening to each student and to the parent or guardian of each student; allows parents and guardians to opt out.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of exhaust gas cleaning systems on vessels; and relates to the powers of the department of environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the regulation of exhaust gas cleaning systems on vessels and provides enforcement mechanisms and remedies for violations; relates to the powers of the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical debt
sponsored.sum: Prohibits money judgments arising from non-payment of facility items and services by a patient or patient guarantor that is brought by a facility; prohibits the enforcement of arbitration agreements or clauses with respect to non-payment of facility items and services by a patient or patient guarantor; relates to the collection of medical debt; requires transparency in hospital pricing.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjournments for right to counsel
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that in any jurisdiction in which a party is eligible under local law for free legal counsel, if such party has in good faith attempted to secure such counsel and is unable to obtain counsel through no fault of their own, the court shall adjourn the trial of the issue for consecutive periods of not less than fourteen days each until the party is able to secure counsel.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to provide for the re-designation of Donald J. Trump State Park
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to conduct a legal review for the re-designation of Donald J. Trump State Park, in Putnam and Westchester counties to a new name.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unlawful use of a New York driver's license or identification card
sponsored.sum: Relates to the unlawful use of a New York driver's license or identification card.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the board of elections to alter the presidential ballot
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the board of elections, or the attorney general in the case of a deadlock, to alter the presidential ballot.

sponsored.t: Relates to the relocation of a charter school
sponsored.sum: Relates to the relocation of a charter school.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the energy performance benchmarking program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the energy performance benchmarking program.

sponsored.t: Directs the NY power authority to oversee mandated energy reduction efforts in state and public authority owned and managed buildings
sponsored.sum: Directs the NY power authority to oversee mandated energy reduction efforts in state and public authority owned and managed buildings.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting certain conditions or preconditions of employment
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from requiring certain conditions or preconditions of employment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes pharmacists to dispense HIV pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis
sponsored.sum: Authorizes pharmacists to dispense HIV pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of legal representation to certain persons in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires counties and/or cities to establish a plan for providing legal counsel to persons who are defendants or respondents in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings and who are financially unable to obtain counsel; defines eligible person as one whose gross individual income is not in excess of one hundred twenty-five percent of the federal income official poverty line; requires the state to match dollar for dollar the amount counties appropriate for their plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting contract provisions that waive certain substantive and procedural rights
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting contract provisions that waive certain substantive and procedural rights relating to a claim of discrimination, non-payment of wages or benefits, retaliation, harassment or violation of public policy in employment.

sponsored.t: Waives the biennial attorney registration fee for New York attorneys who are employed in a public service job
sponsored.sum: Waives the biennial attorney registration fee for New York attorneys who are employed in a public service job.

sponsored.t: Requires compliance with the uniform land use review procedure for the disposition of school property in New York city
sponsored.sum: Requires compliance with the uniform land use review procedure for the disposition of school property in New York city.

sponsored.t: Repeals provision of county law relating to access to records of calls made to a municipality's E911 system
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to records of calls made to a municipality's E911 system.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation by LGBT, disability and veteran-owned businesses in state contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to participation by LGBT, disability and veteran-owned businesses in state contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention team program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention demonstration program.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have a substantial positive fiscal impact on the City of New York by reducing the legal and settlement costs related to unwar- ranted lethal force against the emotionally impaired. Up to 1 million Dollars from the general fund will be used to establish the program.

sponsored.t: Exempts veterans from the payment of certain fees relating to corporations
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans from the payment of certain fees relating to corporations.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens; provides for taxpayer gifts for tick borne illness research, detection and education; establishes the tick borne illness research, detection and education fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all insurance companies to provide the New York city department of transportation with information regarding motor vehicle accidents within such city
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring all insurance companies to provide the New York city department of transportation with information regarding motor vehicle accidents within such city.

sponsored.t: Relates to the right of defendants in misdemeanor or felony cases to have such matter appear before a judge or justice admitted to practice law in New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right of defendants in misdemeanor or felony cases to have such matter appear before a judge or justice admitted to practice law in New York; creates an automatic right to have a case reassigned to an attorney judge.

sponsored.t: Relates to orders of adjournment in contemplation of dismissal and sealing of defendant records
sponsored.sum: Relates to orders of adjournment in contemplation of dismissal by mandating that judges seal certain records of defendants rather than giving judge's discretion for such an action; limits the total period of adjournment to 90 days.

sponsored.t: Provides protection to employees and former employees from retaliatory actions by employers for the reporting of illegal or dangerous business activities
sponsored.sum: Provides protection to employees and former employees from retaliatory actions by employers for the reporting of illegal or dangerous business activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to early literacy education
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to provide instructional programming and services in reading and literacy which are evidence based and aligned with state standards; requires teachers in grades pre-K through five to attend professional development courses in reading education.

sponsored.t: Relates to recoverability of sovereign debt
sponsored.sum: Relates to New York state's support of international debt relief initiatives for certain developing countries.

sponsored.t: Requires certain state owned and operated parking facilities to install and maintain charging stations for plug-in electric vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires certain state owned and operated parking facilities to install and maintain charging stations for plug-in electric vehicles.

sponsored.t: Enacts the student suicide prevention act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the student suicide prevention act; requires the governing board or body of every local educational agency serving students in grades seven to twelve, to adopt policies, procedures and guidelines on student suicide prevention, intervention and postvention for students in such grades.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing the state commissioner of parks, recreation and historic preservation to create a process to approve or deny certain new large urban telecommunication infrastructure
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the state commissioner of parks, recreation and historic preservation to create a process to approve or deny any new large urban telecommunication infrastructure that is proposed to be located within two hundred feet of any site listed on the State Register or the National Register or eligible to be listed on the National Register.

sponsored.t: Relates to restrictions on certain flight operations at municipal facilities; relates to the use of certain heliports
sponsored.sum: Prohibits municipal corporations from permitting the use of publicly owned land for helicopter air transportation operated for the primary purpose of conducting sightseeing tours over New York city or conducting photography, videography, or similar production activities over New York city; relates to the use of certain heliports in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting insurance companies from discriminating based on genetic predisposition; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurance companies from discriminating based on genetic predisposition including refusing to issue or renew, charging any increased rate, or restricting any length of coverage; prohibits insurers from requiring genetic testing.

sponsored.t: Requires that plaintiffs no longer have to prove that a sexual offense occurred on the premises of, chattels or property belonging to a corporate entity
sponsored.sum: Requires that plaintiffs no longer have to prove that a sexual offense occurred on the premises of, chattels or property belonging to a corporate entity in action for negligent supervision.

sponsored.t: Requires fashion sellers to be accountable to standardized environmental and social due diligence policies, and establishes a fashion remediation fund
sponsored.sum: Requires fashion sellers to carry out environmental due diligence for the portions of their business related to wearing apparel, footwear or fashion bags, including wearing apparel, footwear or fashion bags produced as a private label; establishes a fashion remediation fund.

sponsored.t: Classifies pistol converters as a rapid-fire modification device
sponsored.sum: Includes pistol converters in the definition of a rapid-fire modification device.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the presence of epinephrine auto-injector devices on pre-school premises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the presence of epinephrine auto-injector devices on pre-school premises.

sponsored.t: Establishes the climate corporate data accountability act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the climate corporate data accountability act requiring certain business entities within the state to annually disclose scope 1, scope 2 and scope 3 emissions; establishes the climate accountability and emissions disclosure fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to customer service access
sponsored.sum: Requires certain businesses to provide a free, efficient, universally accessible, inclusive, nondiscriminatory and evaluable customer service telephone line; requires corporations to establish an annual customer service call-answer rate of at least ninety percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to the consideration of gender affirming care in custody matters
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a court from granting, denying or deciding a petition for guardianship, custody or visitation solely on the allegation or basis that a parent or guardian is providing or facilitating the provision of gender affirming care to the subject child.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York Determining Obligations and Guaranteeing Enforcement (DOGE) in Government Contracting Act"
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of economic development, in conjunction with the empire state development corporation, to review all contracts entered into or overseen or enforced by the department of economic development and/or the empire state development corporation relating to the leasing of state-owned premises to private parties for the production, manufacture and/or development of solar shingle products, electric vehicle charging networks, advanced driver-assistance systems, and/or supercomputer hardware and to identify and eliminate fraud, abuse or waste by private parties.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York convention center operating corporation to create a pure captive insurance company
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York convention center operating corporation to establish a subsidiary for the purposes of forming a pure captive insurance company.

sponsored.t: Establishes in the city of New York a bicycle lane safety program to enforce certain restrictions on the use of bicycle lanes and/or protected bicycle lanes by means of bicycle lane photo devices
sponsored.sum: Establishes in the city of New York a bicycle lane safety program to enforce certain restrictions on the use of bicycle lanes and/or protected bicycle lanes by means of bicycle lane photo devices.
sponsored.fis: Revenues collected through fines and penalties from this program shall go to the City of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum educational requirements of certain town and village justices
sponsored.sum: Establishes minimum educational requirements of certain town and village justices.

sponsored.t: Restricts the disclosure of personal information by businesses
sponsored.sum: Restricts the disclosure of personal information by businesses; provides that a business that retains a customer's personal information shall make available to the customer free of charge access to, or copies of, all of the customer's personal information retained by the business.

sponsored.t: Provides for absence from school for the mental or behavioral health of the minor
sponsored.sum: Provides for absence from school for the mental or behavioral health of the minor.

sponsored.t: Requires the public school curriculum for children in kindergarten through grade twelve to include a minimum of two hours per week instruction in civics lessons
sponsored.sum: Requires the public school curriculum for children in kindergarten through grade twelve to include a minimum of two hours per week instruction in civics lessons.

sponsored.t: Relates to capping cost sharing for antiviral COVID-19 therapeutics
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies, medical expense indemnity corporations, hospital service corporations, health service corporations and medical assistance programs to provide coverage for prescribed antiviral therapeutics approved by the food and drug administration for the treatment of COVID-19 at no cost to the patient.

sponsored.t: Removes statute of limitations for certain civil actions related to child sexual assault offenses
sponsored.sum: Removes statute of limitations for certain civil actions related to child sexual assault offenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all insurance policies and medical assistance to provide coverage for medically necessary hearing aids for children under 16 years of age
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Isabella's law" to require all health insurance policies and medical assistance to provide insurance coverage for the cost of medically necessary hearing aids for children under the age of 16.

sponsored.t: Requires all municipalities to update all applicable forms and data systems to include a gender "x" option
sponsored.sum: Requires all municipalities that collect demographic information about a person's gender or sex to update all applicable forms and data systems to include a gender "x" option.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting recordkeeping and reporting duties of public notaries
sponsored.sum: Limits recordkeeping and reporting duties of public notaries to electronic notarization acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing June twentieth as Edie Windsor Day
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing June twentieth as Edie Windsor Day.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state healthy and green procurement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state healthy and green procurement act".

sponsored.t: Enacts the "keep kids covered act" to provide automatic continuous enrollment in medical assistance and child health plus for certain children through age five
sponsored.sum: Requires automatic continuous enrollment in medical assistance and child health plus for previously eligible children through age five.

sponsored.t: Enacts the child abuse reporting expansion act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the child abuse reporting expansion act; relates to making clergy members required reporters of child abuse or mistreatment.

sponsored.t: Relates to undisclosed self-dealing
sponsored.sum: Prohibits conduct in an official capacity in connection with the award of a public contract or public grant that is intended to confer an undisclosed benefit on a public servant, a person with whom a public servant has a business or other financial relationship.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to calculate the period of rent reduction due to diminution of services from the date of actual diminution of the services
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to calculate the period of rent reduction due to diminution of services from the date of actual diminution of the services.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "no toxics tent act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of portable temporary shelters for the purposes of prohibitions on the manufacture or sale of products containing highly flammable materials.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party food delivery services to factor compliance with certain vehicle and traffic laws when assigning workers to delivery routes
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party food delivery services to factor compliance with certain vehicle and traffic laws when assigning workers to delivery routes when such delivery may involve the operation of a bicycle with or without electric assist.

sponsored.t: Relates to ballot drop boxes for absentee and early voting ballots
sponsored.sum: Makes technical changes related to ballot drop boxes for absentee and early voting ballots.

sponsored.t: Relates to the recall of class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the recall of a class B firefighting foam; prohibits the sale or distribution of firefighting personal protective equipment that contains intentionally added PFAS.

sponsored.t: Relates to remedies for unlawful discharge or discrimination for the exercise of an employee's right to be absent from employment for jury duty
sponsored.sum: Creates, in addition to the existing sanction of criminal contempt of court, the remedies of labor law civil penalties and employee's right to bring civil action for unlawful discharge, penalty or discrimination on account of the exercise by an employee of a juror's right to be absent from employment by reason of jury service.

sponsored.t: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators, and establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions
sponsored.sum: Requires employment and consumer dispute arbitrations to be submitted to neutral third party arbitrators; establishes prohibited arbitration agreements and provisions; requires disclosure of information by certain arbitrators.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription labels for gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, pubertal suppressants, anabolic steroids, alpha reductase inhibitors, progestins, or drug classes for hormone replacement therapy
sponsored.sum: Provides that prescription labels for gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, pubertal suppressants, anabolic steroids, alpha reductase inhibitors, progestins, or drug classes for hormone replacement therapy maybe include the name of the dispensing practice instead of the prescriber; provides for notice to patients.

sponsored.t: Establishes the climate protection insurance act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the insure our communities act to implement climate leadership and community protection act targets for insurers; identifies and protects such communities; relates to affordability of insurance rates; assesses covered insurance companies' record of performance at meeting insurance needs; requires covered insurance companies to file statistical reports, including information on insurance coverage in specific assessment areas and disadvantaged communities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of three-dimensional printed firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to the regulation of three-dimensional printed firearms; provides that a person who intentionally sells, distributes, or disposes of a three-dimensional printed firearm is guilty of a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring property owners to dedicate certain residential units to rent regulated status following demolition and new construction or substantial renovation
sponsored.sum: Requires property owners to dedicate certain residential units to rent regulated status following demolition and new construction or substantial renovation.

sponsored.t: Relates to birth certificates for foreign adoptions
sponsored.sum: Relates to birth certificates for foreign adoptions; makes certain provisions retroactive.

sponsored.t: Relates to equal pay disclosure with respect to state contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to equal pay disclosure with respect to state contracts; requires contractors to submit a summary of the contractor's workforce pay averages, calculated by job category, gender, race, and ethnicity, and the difference between pay averages in each category; requires such reports to be made public; and provides for damages for willful or intentional violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the fees certain notaries public shall be entitled to from two dollars to five dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to tax abatements for building owners in a city having a population of one million or more who complete exterior repairs
sponsored.sum: Provides tax abatements for building owners in a city having a population of one million or more who complete exterior repairs to covered buildings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the admissibility into evidence of statements in learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets
sponsored.sum: Permits the admissibility into evidence of statements in learned treatises, periodicals, or pamphlets if the statement is called to the attention of an expert witness and the publication is established as a reliable authority by the expert's admission or testimony, by another expert's testimony, or by judicial notice.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disqualification of a surviving spouse
sponsored.sum: Provides for the disqualification of a surviving spouse if the marriage is annulled or voided after the death of the spouse.

sponsored.t: Limits the admissibility of evidence of a defendant's creative or artistic expression against such defendant in a criminal proceeding
sponsored.sum: Establishes an assumption of the inadmissibility of evidence of a defendant's creative or artistic expression against such defendant in a criminal proceeding; requires the proffering party to affirmatively prove that the evidence is admissible by clear and convincing evidence.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for State or local government.

sponsored.t: Relates to surrogacy programs and agreements
sponsored.sum: Makes various amendments to a chapter governing surrogacy programs and agreements.

sponsored.t: Requires motorcycles to be registered at point of sale
sponsored.sum: Requires motorcycles to be registered at point of sale.

sponsored.t: Provides coverage for iatrogenic fertility preservation services under certain conditions
sponsored.sum: Provides coverage for iatrogenic fertility preservation services when caused by a medical treatment.

sponsored.t: Establishes the diversity in investment act requiring certain venture capital companies to report diversity information about its funding determinations
sponsored.sum: Establishes the diversity in investment act requiring certain venture capital companies to report diversity information about its funding determinations; requires reports to be published on the venture capital companies' websites; establishes penalties for failure to complete and publish such reports.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of allowance that trial and grand jurors are entitled to in each court of the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of allowance that trial and grand jurors are entitled to in each court of the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Regulates the sale of oral nicotine pouches
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulating the sale of oral nicotine pouches.

sponsored.t: Updates school concussion management and response protocols
sponsored.sum: Relates to updating school concussion management and response protocols; requires that the injured student have returned to a full class schedule without academic accommodations prior to resuming athletic activity.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's height or weight in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's height or weight in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations.

sponsored.t: Includes a class three bicycle with electric assist in the definition of limited use motorcycle
sponsored.sum: Includes a class three bicycle with electric assist in the definition of limited use motorcycle.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of biometric surveillance technology by law enforcement; establishes the biometric surveillance regulation task force; and provides for the expiration and repeal of certain provisions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of biometric surveillance technology by law enforcement; establishes the biometric surveillance regulation task force; provides for the expiration and repeal of certain provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the hospitalization, care coordination, and assisted outpatient treatment for persons with mental illness by qualified clinical examiners or qualified mental health professionals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the hospitalization, care coordination, and assisted outpatient treatment for persons with mental illness by qualified clinical examiners or qualified mental health professionals; defines qualified clinical examiner and qualified mental health professional.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to establishing the New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit and establishing the New York state council on the arts cultural program fund; relates to the New York city musical and theatrical production tax credit.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable New York state taxpayers to electronically file income tax returns free of charge
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable each New York state taxpayer to prepare and electronically file such taxpayer's federal and state income tax returns free of charge.

sponsored.t: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
sponsored.sum: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to adult vaccination reporting requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires a health care provider who administers an immunization to a person nineteen years of age or older to report such information to the department of health or to the New York city citywide immunization registry unless the person receiving the immunization objects to such reporting.

sponsored.t: Enacts the dark skies protection act
sponsored.sum: Regulates outdoor night lighting to preserve and enhance the state's dark sky.

sponsored.t: Relates to the safe landings for youth leaving foster care act or safe landings act
sponsored.sum: Modifies the safe landings for youth leaving foster care act or safe landings act to allow for the conversion of certain motions to become motions to return a respondent to foster care.
sponsored.fis: Indeterminable fiscal implications to the State and local governments.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees; creates the offenses of leaving the scene of an accident involving a bicycle with electric assist without reporting in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Restricts a law enforcement officer from initiating a traffic stop for certain violations of the vehicle and traffic law
sponsored.sum: Restricts a law enforcement officer from initiating a traffic stop for certain violations of the vehicle and traffic law; provides for the suppression or exclusion of evidence obtained in violation of such provisions; relates to the duties of the division of criminal justice services making certain information pertaining to traffic stops public.

sponsored.t: Relates to strategic lawsuits against public participation and makes technical corrections
